text_block_list.text:
While heading out to training with Air 
Groove...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Well, it's Air Groove-senpai, so...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Right, that racing outfit...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Is something wrong with me?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh, Air Groove-senpai!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Um... let's see...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? Were you talking about 
something hard to bring up?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Um... that's not true at all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"We were just talking about how pretty 
Senpai's new racing racewear is..."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You wear it so gorgeously, it's really 
amazing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We were just casually talking about how 
we'd love to see that up close...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see. If that is the case, then I shall 
say it is an honor.
choice_data_list:
Why don't you try on your racing outfit 
and show them?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Why? We're about to start training. There 
is no time for that.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Right...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Fine. Just this once. I'll wear 
it for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yay!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: âI went ahead and put it on for you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Haaah. Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
A top-class racing outfit really is a 
sight to behold just by wearing it, isn't 
it...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's not true.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Putting on your racewear isn't the end. 
Rather, it could be said to be the 
beginning.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A forged physique and the beauty of a 
racing racewear come together, sublimating 
into something even more refined.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, the design of the outfit is not 
everything. Only when one is worthy of the 
outfit does its true brilliance shine 
forth.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Though, I too am only halfway along my 
own path.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...That's not true at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"At least to us, Air Groove-senpai is 
top-class!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You all...
choice_data_list:
Gotta keep polishing our skills from here 
on out.

Gotta keep polishing our skills from here 
on out.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You all...
choice_data_list:
Gotta keep polishing our skills from here 
on out.

Gotta keep polishing our skills from here 
on out.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I intended to do so even without you 
telling me. My bond with my racing attire 
will never end.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Once you wear it, your only choice is to 
continually elevate yourself. Unlike a 
race, there is no finish line on this 
path..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
A road without a finish line... What an 
endless, punishing path...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yet it is well worth the cost. At least, 
that is what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I must head to training. Excuse 
me.
With that, Air Groove headed off to train.

With the envious gazes of her juniors upon 
her back...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Stop that, not you too.
choice_data_list: Still, because it truly is shining.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Nnh... Very well. Well, I appreciate your 
praise.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, I have no intention of being 
satisfied here. I will continue to polish 
myself and shine even brighter.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet, Dober. Keep honing yourselves, 
both of you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So that one day, you'll shine brighter 
than anyone else.

Leaving her inspired junior behind, Air 
Groove headed off to training.
